name: data-reasoning
description: Skills for reasoning from data — structured exploration that generates honest leads, and hypothesis-driven investigation that adjudicates them.

interface.shortDescription: Explore data and test hypotheses with disciplined workflows
interface.longDescription: Use paired workflows for structured exploratory data analysis and hypothesis-driven investigation with explicit evidence, predictions, and stopping rules.
defaultPrompt: Explore this dataset and identify the strongest leads.
Turn this question into a hypothesis-driven analysis plan.
Evaluate whether the evidence supports these competing hypotheses.
